reviews.title: Update has ruined the app
reviews.text: The “big” update from a few months ago that rolled out this tile system for the splash page / library has got to be the absolute worst thing Lego could have done. It is now almost impossible to find a certain set or collection of sets to see if you have something by scrolling your library. Since I have over 200 sets I now have to type in the build number on the search page for each item to individually check if you have that set / registered it. Please go back to the old way, they way that was actually user friendly, or at least give us an option to revert back to or keep the new tile system. Would be an easy 5 star review if y’all didn’t put out the update.

reviews.title: Can’t use it as my library anymore with the new UI
reviews.text:
I used the app on my iPhone (1) to keep track of the many sets we have at home, and occasionally (2) to better visualize complex steps in builds. 

Latest updates made the first (my main use) impossible:
  1. Sets used to be displayed as a list (thumbnail/name) grouped by themes. Now each set appears as a large tile, in which a picture of the box appears, but not the name.  The tiles are so large that only a single tile can be shown on the screen in full at any time. 
  2. When moving among the tiles, after every move the app puts the nearest tile at the center of the screen, which makes it jump between current position and the closest tile’s center every single time you move.
  3. You would think, since they decided to use such an interface, they would include the ability to search among your sets.  No, you can’t.  You can filter them by theme, but that’s not useful at all unless you have only a handful of sets within that theme.

As an additional annoyance, I now need to sign in every single time I launch the app, though I’d be willing to live with that, if the app served its purpose. 

It’s unbelievable that a giant company like Lego screwed this app up so spectacularly. It’s not like they lack the resources, after all.

reviews.title: Nightmare update
reviews.text: The update to the home user interface showing your Lego collection as tiles instead of an orderly listed format as shown previously (and like the sets on search still are) is the worst big change to an app I’ve experienced in a while. This hits home hard as a neurodivergent parent raising two autistic kids whose special interest is Lego. My son has cried for 2 days now begging me to fix it. Change is hard for autistics and not having things nice and neat and in order is a nightmare. PLEASE fix this or at least give the option to toggle back to the old way. I don’t know who ever thought this was a good idea. Check your Reddit threads and reviews. The Lego AND autistic community is beyond upset over this change. This is truly not ok. Please bring order back to your app so we can view our collections as we did previously.

reviews.title: Hate New Home Screen
reviews.text:
I hate how the home screen is displayed now. It looks like a phone background/wallpaper. I liked how all my sets were displayed before in a list with theme buttons at the top that were easy to access. Now you have to swipe all across the screen to find a set and have to tap an option for a popup to appear to filter sets. How are these changes better? Feels like it was changed just to change something, not to make it a better UI. Please, revert back to the previous look. I may just make a spreadsheet for my collection and not even bother with the app.

Edit: I received a developer response stating a list view has been added, but I don’t see it anywhere. I see a sort option, but that’s not the same thing.

reviews.title: PLEASE HELP!  Loss of build together and 3d builder app features
reviews.text: Bricklink Builder Series is such an amazing part of Lego.  Being able to build sets for experienced builders using the Lego Builder app was amazing.  Being able to rotate the models etc to ensure placement was so helpful.  Not to mention the amazing, “build together” feature.  We would have groups of friends over to “build together “ while hanging out and having fun with our friends.  The detail of the Bricklink Designer series is AMAZING.  Now, all of a sudden, the builder app only features the PDF.  Apparently, they are only going to offer the PDFs going forward.  You have great technology and it should be put to use to “build” the community and building experience.  This is a disappointment and true loss.
